sources.entry: Dynamic Dark Mode - Dynamic Dark Mode is the app you are looking for to power up Dark Mode on macOS Mojave and beyond.

summary.one_liner: Dynamic Dark Mode is a macOS menu bar app that automatically switches the system between light and dark appearance on a schedule, at sunset, or based on ambient light.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a menu bar icon that toggles Dark Mode without digging through System Preferences. It enables dark mode after sunset, in dim light, or at any time the user chooses, and switches back to light mode in the morning. The app is said to work with macOS Mojave and later. The README's comparison table lists daylight scheduling, custom scheduling, ambient light, Touch Bar, shortcut key, and menu bar support, and localization. Ambient light changes depend on the "Automatically adjust brightness" setting in System Preferences. The README also includes a comparison table of alternative apps.
use_cases: Automatically switch macOS to dark mode at night
Reduce eye strain from bright screens in the evening
Toggle macOS dark mode from the menu bar
Schedule dark mode by sunset or custom times
Find alternatives to built-in macOS dark mode scheduling
how_to_run: brew cask install dynamic-dark-mode (for older Homebrew versions)
Or download the latest release directly from the project's release page
stack: Swift (not named in the README; omitted)
notable: Menu bar toggle for macOS Dark Mode
Ambient light changes via screen brightness sensing
Comparison table of alternative macOS dark mode apps
caveats: macOS only; the README targets macOS Mojave and later
Ambient light mode requires the 'Automatically adjust brightness' System Preferences option
